_doc: GET /api/fonts (docs/contracts/fonts/README.md): the members of the answer, of a face, of a slice and of a pack, in the order the server writes them; urlPattern every slice url matches; empty is the answer with no font pack installed. order lists the faces (face, script, weight) the Go test pack yields, in answer order: faces.json lists them as kai/Jpan, sans/Hans 700, sans/Hans 400.
